question: I would like to know the given names of baseball players who have achieved the highest value of games played, runs, hits, and home runs, with their corresponding score values.
sql:
SELECT 
  p.name_given,
  p.name_first,
  p.name_last,
  b.player_id,
  b.g as games,
  b.r as runs,
  b.h as hits,
  b.hr as home_runs
FROM batting b
JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE TRY_CAST(b.g AS BIGINT) = 165
   OR TRY_CAST(b.r AS BIGINT) = 192
   OR TRY_CAST(b.h AS BIGINT) = 262
   OR TRY_CAST(b.hr AS BIGINT) = 73
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(b.g AS BIGINT) = 165 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
  CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(b.r AS BIGINT) = 192 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
  CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(b.h AS BIGINT) = 262 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
  CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(b.hr AS BIGINT) = 73 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
